title: Choices in the date request and report screens
decision: After a decline the button to ask again is hidden for seven days with the date it returns; requests sit with disputes in the workspace; days without activity are left out of the report's table and counted; the report opens on the current month; a response whose totals do not add up is shown with a warning, not hidden; staff are named by role and the end of their membership identifier because the API gives no names
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 48
rationale: The requirements name what the screens must offer, not their arrangement
